premises: A stepwise thermo-mechanical treatment can sequentially induce coherent δ-lamella and γ″ nanoprecipitates in a W-based refractory HEA.
These coherent nanoprecipitates enhance dislocation transmission and promote progressive strain hardening.
The sequential precipitation increases yield strength through particle shearing while delaying plastic instability, improving ductility.
The treated alloy achieves ~2.15 GPa tensile strength and ~15% ductility at ambient temperature, and >1 GPa strength at elevated temperature.
This performance is a noticeable improvement over conventional single-precipitation processed HEAs.
